pages.text: Spirit stones can be upgraded in tier from crafting, but can also be dropped from snakes and mined from spirit stone veins and or spirit geodes.
Spirit fruits can be harvested from bonsais which grow in the wilderness. They also increase aspect proficiency gain.
Pills can be crafted from spirit stones and fruit. $(br)This is just an example, there are higher tiered pills you can craft using higher tiered materials.
A rare material that augments elemental pierce and resistance when used in tools and or armor.
Dropped when a cultivator losses all their lives used in demonic cultivation.
